parameters.name: CallBack
parameters.description: The URL for receiving callback notifications. Currently, only HTTP URLs are supported.

parameters.name: Input
parameters.description:
The Object Storage Service (OSS) location of the input video. The region of the OSS bucket must be the same as the region where you use Media Processing Service (MPS).

>

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: The watermark level. This parameter specifies the color channels for embedding the watermark. Valid values: 0 (U channel), 1 (UV channels), and 2 (YUV channels).

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: The Object Storage Service (OSS) location for the job output. You must specify the output directory by using the `Dir` parameter.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time for embedding the watermark, in seconds.

parameters.name: TotalTime
parameters.description: The total duration for embedding the watermark, in seconds.

parameters.name: Url
parameters.description: A publicly accessible URL of the video. This URL overrides the `Input` parameter.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: The custom user data. The maximum length is 1,024 bytes.
